Definition: from G2596 and G906; to throw down:--cast down, lay.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says we are cast down but not destroyed, and Hebrews urges us to leave the first principles behind and go on, laying down the foundation once and for all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being thrown down is not the same as being finished, because God picks up what men cast down.
